caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent greenish-blue glass pitcher with an exaggeratedly wide, curved spout and a smoothly rounded body that tapers near the top. The surface of the pitcher is adorned with several raised, horizontal bands wrapping around the upper portion, and it features a large, ornate handle attached to the right side. The glass is shaded to indicate its translucent quality and reflective surface. The pitcher sits on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects present. At the bottom, below the pitcher, there is a horizontal scale marked 0 to 3 and the artist’s signature, “John Tarrantino,” is written to the left of the scale.
title: Pitcher
